audience: car park operators who track vehicles, camera visits and parking occupancy in ParkPow

useCases.title: Check which vehicles visited a car park
useCases.text: List the visits of a period, filtered by plate, site or vehicle details. Open one visit to read its cameras, times, duration and score.

useCases.title: Export a large set of visits
useCases.text: Export visits in cursor pages when a period has more visits than the standard list returns. Pass the cursor from each reply to the next call.

useCases.title: Show live parking occupancy by site
useCases.text: List the parking sites with their cameras and occupancy. Read one site to see its total spaces and the spaces still available.

useCases.title: Look up a vehicle and its notes
useCases.text: Find vehicles by plate, make, colour or type. Read the tags and comments that the account keeps on each vehicle.

useCases.title: Record a permit or tenant on a vehicle
useCases.text: Create a vehicle, or update the one ParkPow matches to the plate, with tenant or permit fields. Set a tag to mark its status.

useCases.title: Add a note when a permit expires
useCases.text: Add a comment to a vehicle, such as a note that its permit has expired. Each call adds a new comment, so send it once.
